name: Yippee Creamy Corn Pasta
ingredients_raw: PASTA: WHEAT SEMOLINA (99.3%), PAPRIKA EXTRACT POWDER (0.4%) AND SPINACH EXTRACT POWDER (0.3%). CREAMY CORN PASTA SAUCEMAKER: MILK SOLIDS (35.1%), IODIZED SALT, STARCH, SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, DEHYDRATED GARLIC BITS, ONION POWDER, DEHYDRATED CORN (4.0%), FAT POWDER, SPICES AND CONDIMENTS, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, ACIDITY REGULATOR [INS 331(iii)], DEHYDRATED CHIVES (1.1%), FLAVOUR ENHANCERS (INS 627, INS 631), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551), NATURAL FLAVOURS AND NATURAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, THICKENER (INS 415) AND YEAST EXTRACT.
